title: Conditional List
description: Evaluates conditions and places features from the first matching entry. Each entry has a condition expression and associated feature—when the condition passes, that feature generates and later entries are skipped. Enables biome-dependent variants or terrain-responsive structure selection during world generation.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The name of this feature in the form 'namespace_name:feature_name'. 'feature_name' must match the filename.

anyOf.title: Conditional Features
anyOf.description: Array of Features, and their associated Conditions, for attempted placement. These features will be evaluated as ordered.

early_out_scheme.title: Early Out Scheme"<"condition Success", "placement Success"
early_out_scheme.description: Denote whether placement should end on first successful placement or first passed condition.
